title: Starting a Victorian rental agreement
description: The paperwork and steps before and when a Victorian renter signs. Summarised from Consumer Affairs Victoria guidance on rental agreements, disclosures, applications, condition reports, bonds and rent payment.

sources.title: Knowing your rights when signing an agreement
Lodging the bond with the RTBA
Rent payments and rent in advance

items.title: Check the property meets the rental minimum standards before you advertise
Take applications only on the Victorian rental application form, with no application fee
items.detail: Ask only for what the form sets out. No rental bidding and no more than one month's rent in advance.

items.title: Give the renter your written disclosures before they sign
items.detail: Sale plans, mortgagee action, embedded network, last gas and electrical check dates, asbestos, mould or damp notices, building orders and owners corporation matters.

items.title: Prepare the agreement on the Victorian residential rental agreement form
Give the renter the Renters Guide
Give 2 signed copies (or 1 electronic copy) of the Victorian condition report template before move-in
items.detail: Attach dated photos. The renter returns it within 5 business days of moving in.

items.title: Take no more than one month's rent as bond and lodge it with the RTBA within 14 days
items.detail: Unless the rent is more than $900 a week.

items.title: Set up a fee-free way to pay rent, including Centrepay
Give written information on how the smoke alarms work and how to test them
Give your name, postal address and an urgent repairs phone number
Give a key to each renter who signed
Give the renter the owners corporation rules
Have the pool barrier compliance certificate ready to give the renter on request
Give the renter a copy of the signed agreement
